title: 1882 Herzegovina uprising
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1882 Herzegovina uprising", at revision 1370278928, opens: "The 1882 Herzegovina uprising was an uprising by Serbian and Bosniak populations in Bosnia and Herzegovina against Austro-Hungarian rule. It was preceded by the Herzegovina uprising of 1875–1877." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q12019518, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "uprising in Bosnia and Herzegovina against Austro-Hungarian rule". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
